flags.zik_bonded: set: act1 beat 4 (accept the light-moth at the feast) or act2 entry 150 / beat 2 (second chance). used: act2 maze help, act3 Zik reveal + true name, act4 true ending + vein path guide
flags.zik_hurt: set: act2 maze (used Zik as bait) or act3 stairs (let Zik shield you). used: act4 Zik cannot guide in veins (extra fight) and true ending needs no_flag zik_hurt OR חלום>=6
flags.neriya_ally: set: act1 alchemy (help Neriya) / act2 maze (rescue her) / warrior always at act1 page 2. used: act3 duel seeding + Shaked blade for warrior, act4 boss help + true ending ally
flags.neriya_slighted: set: act1/act2 (humiliate, abandon in maze, mock her family). used: act3 she sabotages your duel (enemy +1 skill), act4 she sides with Aderet at first
flags.rom_covered: set: act1 investigation (keep Rom's secret about stealing answers). used: act3 Rom yields the duel / gives tip, act4 Rom carries the lower city evacuation (enables win 391)
flags.rom_exposed: set: act1 investigation (tell Aderet Rom was in the hall). used: act2 Rom on probation and hostile at duel club, act3 Rom duel at skill 9, act4 Rom absent
flags.stole_answers: set: act1 alchemy (steal Tuval's answer sheet). used: act2 Gomer/Aderet notice (חשד +1 at entry), act3 Rom blackmails you unless rom_covered
flags.gave_journal: set: act1 end (hand Tuval's journal to Aderet). used: act2 library decode impossible, act3 Aderet tries the Stone Word on you (stat check), act4 Aderet knows you
flags.gomer_friend: set: act1 (help Gomer with the gargoyle feed / return lost-and-found) or act2 entry 150 (don't report him). used: act3 detention escape + rest, act3 exit to 340, act4 Gomer recognizes Timna
flags.library_secret: set: act2 forbidden library (read the Founders' Chronicle). used: act3 Edna talks, accusation scene, act4 talk-down of Aderet
flags.edna_met: set: act2 forbidden library (answered Edna's riddle). used: act3 Edna trades the true name for the maze rose
flags.spared_double: set: act2 hall of mirrors (spare your mirror-double). used: act4 the double takes one blow for you in the heart (skip a fight / heal)
flags.duel_champion: set: act2 duel club tournament (win the final). used: act3 arena crowd favors you (+1 ניקוד on duel win), act4 Rom respects you
flags.tuval_restored: set: act3 (pour שיקוי ריכוך on Tuval). used: act3 Tuval names Aderet; act4 Tuval binds Aderet (boss hp 10) and is an ally for true ending
flags.aderet_exposed: set: act3 feast accusation (needs יומן טובל or tuval_restored, + library_secret or check). used: act3 exit -> 340; act4 Aderet flees into the heart, no escort guards
flags.knows_true_name: set: act3 (Edna for ורד המבוך, or Zik if zik_bonded and חלום>=3, or the stairs' carved verse). used: act4 true ending, bypass boss
flags.heart_shard: set: act3 (Zik leads you to a living vein, you take a שבב לב item and set this flag on the same page). used: act4 calms the antibodies on the vein path
flags.toasted_seventh: easter egg. set: act1 feast (toast the empty seventh chair). used: act4 Edna appears in the heart once: heal 4
flags.gargoyle_petted: easter egg. set: act1 bridge (scratch the old gargoyle Gravel under the chin). used: act4 Gravel catches you on a fall (one death page becomes survival)
flags.gnome_freed: easter egg. set: act2 maze (free the cursed garden gnome Pipkin). used: act3 Pipkin pays you 3 gold + one hint at the stairs

items.הזמנה חתומה: start_effects for every class. act1 thief reveal (your name is on it); act4 the heart door opens only for an invitation (on the 340 path the alternative is Zik)
items.גלימת האקדמיה: armor 1. given free to every contestant at act1 enrollment (beat 3)
items.יומן טובל: act1 Tuval's study. act2 decoded in the library, act3 proof for accusation (lost if gave_journal)
items.מפתח הספרייה: act1 Gomer's gift (gomer_friend) or thief steals it. act2 opens the forbidden library without a check
items.שיקוי ריכוך: act1 alchemy trial (correct recipe) or act3 Gomer's shop (12 gold). act3 restore Tuval OR act4 free Timna's hand / cure yourself
items.רסיס מראה: act2 hall of mirrors (taken from your double's frame). act4 boss: see through Aderet's veil (skill -2)
items.ורד המבוך: act2 maze center. act3 give to Edna for the true name (or give to Neriya: neriya_ally)
items.שרביט דו-קרב: weapon +2. act2 duel club prize or bazaar (8 gold). act3 duel
items.להב בית שקד: weapon +3. act3 Neriya gives it to the warrior (or any class if neriya_ally and duel won). act4 boss
items.שבב לב: act3 living vein. act4 vein path: calms antibodies; heart: alternative to the invitation
items.גרב בודדה: easter egg. act1 Gomer's lost-and-found. act4 put it on Timna's bare stone foot: +1 luck
items.שיקוי ריפוי: standard. start item; shops in act1/2/3
items.ערכת פריצה: thief start item (lockpicking class moments in every act)
items.ספר לחשים: mage start item (reading runes, class moments)
items.לפיד: start item. act2 maze night segment, act4 veins

counters.ניקוד: trial score. each of trials 1-6 gives 0/1/2 (act1: trials 1-2, act2: 3-4, act3: 5-6). checked: act2 entry board, act3 exit (>=5 -> 300 official path), act4 who the tower 'chooses'
counters.חשד: faculty suspicion. +1 for curfew, theft, caught lies. act1 end: >=4 -> bad ending 90. act2 end: >=3 -> exit 250 (detention). act3: >=5 Aderet uses the Stone Word on you (check). act3 entry 250 sets it back to 1
counters.חלום: bond with the living tower (listen to walls, kindness to Zik and tower creatures, sparing). +1 each. act3: >=3 Zik tells the true name. act4: >=5 needed for true ending; >=7 heart calms without a fight
